name: robots/strands-labs__robots
title: Yahboom ROSMASTER M3 Pro
intro: Yahboom ROSMASTER M3 Pro, adapted from strands-labs/robots. It reads `connected`, `observation`, `commanded_arm_pose` and `sensors`; runs `move_joints`, `home`, `set_gripper`, `drive_base` and 1 more. `move_joints`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
